text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: On a turn, rear wheels track inside the path of the front wheels. Longer combinations off-track more.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Corner / curb -- rear tires can climb it if you turn too soon

text.tspan: Enter a turn from farther out so the rear
axles have room on the inside.
Off-tracking is worse at low speed in a tight
corner (rear goes inside) and can go the other
way at higher speed (rear can swing wide).
Watch space on the inside of the turn, mirrors,
and overhead clearance as the trailer swings.
